audit.why: Kit: E Justice Punch 11s-7s, 650-range knockup dash with a step-back wind-up; W Shield of Durand 18s-14s taunt charge; Q Winds of War 11s-7s projectile (reflectable); R 180/160/140s global.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse online — the execute threshold turns your chip war into a countdown he can see.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance at 6 is a 180-second global — his tempo swing; match his shove or a sidelane pays.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - W Rebuttal spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Justice Punch (E): 11s at rank 1 — his only engage; when it whiffs, that's your trade window. - Shield of Durand (W): 18s taunt charge — poke while it's down. - Hero's Entrance: 180s global. Rebuttal reflects Winds of War (Q); the dash is not a projectile.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: Galio steps back before Justice Punch launches — root that wind-up and the dash never fires; after a whiff he has no engage for 11s.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: His E travels 650 and knocks up on contact — a stationary Mel mid-volley is exactly the target he wants; keep moving till it's spent.
